issues.issue: The revised pages cut General Fund spending by 20,000 and add 20,000 to its ending balance (net cash +10,000, investments +10,000). The Schedule of Investments still agrees with the crossed-out version, so the revision isn't backed by the investment detail. Using the revised pages is defensible and the gap is in report_discrepancies, but someone should decide whether the revised figures are supported. decision_needed has no entry for this.
